steps.title: Check
steps.body: The rook on a1 gives check. The white king is attacked along the first rank. The king must escape, or a piece must block or capture the rook.

steps.title: Escape
steps.body: Get out of check by moving the king.
steps.hint: Leave the first rank, where the rook is attacking.
steps.success: Escaped. Any square off the first rank works here.

steps.title: Checkmate
steps.body: Checkmate: the king is in check and cannot escape. Here its own pawns block every square it could run to.

steps.title: Stalemate
steps.body: Stalemate: Black has no legal move and is not in check. The game is a draw.

steps.question: What is stalemate?
options: No legal moves, and not in check
steps.explanation: Stalemate is a draw. The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not attacked.
